headline: Sanjeev Kumar Singhal resigns as CFO of AMD Industries
summary: AMD Industries Limited has announced that Mr. Sanjeev Kumar Singhal is stepping down from his position as Chief Financial Officer. The resignation will take effect from October 21, 2026. Retail investors should note potential executive transitions in smaller-cap firms.
why_it_matters: CFO exit warrants monitoring management stability.

headline: AMD Industries discloses promoter share transfer under SEBI regulations
hook: Routine promoter stake shift at AMD Industries
summary: AMD Industries Limited has submitted a disclosure under Regulation 10(6) of SEBI SAST regulations regarding a change in promoter shareholding. Such disclosures inform the stock exchanges about acquisitions or transfers of shares among promoters without triggering open offer requirements. Retail investors in micro-cap stocks need to monitor these internal equity shifts for potential changes in promoter commitment. The filing provides regulatory transparency on the company's internal share structure.
why_it_matters: Internal promoter shifts have minimal immediate impact on retail portfolio value.
